DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。口座のお手続きで、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your bank account procedures?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先へ給与の振込先を出したいです。職場では新しい姓ですが、通帳は前の姓なので、どう確認するか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与の振込先を提出したいが職場の新姓と通帳の旧姓が違うため、確認方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to give my employer my account details for salary payments. I use my new surname at work, but my bankbook has my previous surname, so I would like advice on how to check this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to check the salary payment account details you need to submit because your new surname at work differs from the old surname in your bankbook. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座名義の変更は、すでにお申し込みになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you already applied to change the account holder's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。書類の振込先だけ新しい姓に直そうとしていましたが、口座の表示と違ってしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義変更はまだ申し込んでおらず、提出書類だけ新姓に書き換えると口座の表示と違ってしまうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I was going to change only the payment details on the form to my new surname, but that would differ from the name shown on the account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not applied for the name change and that changing only the submitted form to your new surname would make it differ from the account's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込先に書く名義と、口座名義の変更手続きを分けて確認しましょう。勤務先への提出期限は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the name to write for the payment destination separately from the procedure to change the account holder's name. Is there a deadline for submitting the details to your employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今週中です。間に合うと決めつけず、名義変更に必要なものと、完了を確認する方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出期限は今週中だが間に合うと決めつけず、必要書類と名義変更の完了確認方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: By the end of this week. I do not want to assume it will be finished in time, so I would like to know what is required and how to confirm the name change is complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the submission deadline is this week, but without assuming it will be met, ask about the required documents and how to confirm the account name change is complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類や手続きの状況は担当がご案内します。勤務先にも現在の名義と変更予定を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person in charge will explain the required documents and procedure status. Please also tell your employer the current account name and your plans to change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社へは、旧姓の口座を持っていて変更はまだだと説明します。新姓で入金できると自分で保証しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社に旧姓名義の口座で変更は未完了だと伝え、新姓で入金できるとは自分で保証しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will explain to my company that the account is under my previous surname and has not been changed yet. I will not personally guarantee that payments can be made under my new surname.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell your company the account remains under your previous surname and the change is incomplete, and will not personally guarantee payment under your new surname. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにしてください。口座の情報を提出する際は、担当と勤務先双方の案内を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do that. When submitting your account information, check the guidance from both the person in charge and your employer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名義変更の担当へ相談してから会社へ状況を伝えます。提出欄を自分の判断だけで新姓に書き換えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者へ名義変更を相談して会社に状況を知らせ、提出欄を自己判断だけで新姓に書き換えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will consult the person handling name changes and then tell my company the situation. I will not change the submitted field to my new surname solely on my own judgment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will consult the person in charge about changing the account name, inform your company of the situation, and not rewrite the field with your new surname solely on your own judgment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お買い物で何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with your shopping?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この魚を買いたいのですが、棚の値引き表示がどの商品に当たるのか見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 魚を買いたいが、棚の値引き表示がどの商品を指すのか確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy this fish. Could you check which product the discount sign on the shelf applies to?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help checking which product the shelf's discount sign refers to because you want to buy some fish. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示の品名と、手に取った商品の品名を比べましょう。どの表示をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the product name on the sign with the one you picked up. Which sign did you see?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤い表示です。よく読むと、隣の小さいパックの名前でした。私が持っている大きいパックとは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤い表示は隣の小さいパックの品名で、自分が持つ大きいパックとは違うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The red one. Reading it carefully, I see it names the small pack next to this one. It is different from the large pack I am holding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the red sign names the neighboring small pack, which differs from the large pack you are holding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、このパックの表示を確認しましょう。量を優先されますか、それとも予算を決めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us check the label for this pack. Is quantity your priority, or do you have a set budget?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は一人分で予算も決めています。安いと思って大きい方を選びましたが、小さい方で足りそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分で予算も決めており、安いと思って選んだ大きいパックではなく小さい方を検討したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today I only need enough for one person, and I have a set budget. I chose the large one thinking it was cheap, but the small one seems sufficient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you need one serving and have a set budget, and want to consider the small pack rather than the large one you chose thinking it was cheap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 小さい方を確認できます。すでにかごに入れた商品は、開封していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can check the small one. Have you opened any products already in your basket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらも開けていません。試食を食べたことと、購入するパックを開けたことを混ぜて答えてしまいそうでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: どちらのパックも未開封で、試食を食べたことと購入品を開けたことは別だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have not opened either pack. I nearly confused eating a sample with opening the pack I am going to buy when answering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that both packs are unopened and that eating a sample is separate from opening the product you will buy. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未開封ですね。売場で状態を確認して戻し、選ぶパックの品名と価格をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: They are unopened, then. Let us check their condition in the sales area before returning them, and please check the product name and price of the pack you choose.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大きい方を戻せるか確認し、小さい方の品名と価格を見て選びます。値引き表示だけで判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きい方を戻せるか確かめ、小さい方の品名と価格を確認して選び直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check whether I can return the large one, then choose after looking at the small one's name and price. I will not judge by the discount sign alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check whether the large pack can be returned and choose again after checking the small pack's name and price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。売場でご一緒に確認します。お買い物ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check together in the sales area. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何かお手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything I can help you with in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人から借りた双眼鏡が見当たりません。公園で使ったので、届いていないか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人から借りた双眼鏡が見当たらないので、公園に届けられていないか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot find the binoculars I borrowed from an acquaintance. I used them in the park, so I would like to ask whether they have been handed in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether binoculars you borrowed from an acquaintance have been handed in at the park because you cannot find them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に使った場所と、双眼鏡の特徴を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you tell me where you last used them and describe the binoculars?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池を見た場所で使いました。黒い双眼鏡ですが、メーカー名は覚えていません。借りた物なので知人にも聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池を見た場所で黒い双眼鏡を使ったがメーカー名は覚えておらず、持ち主にも聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I used them where I was looking at the pond. They are black, but I do not remember the manufacturer. Since I borrowed them, I will ask the owner too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you used black binoculars at the spot where you viewed the pond, do not remember the manufacturer, and will ask the owner too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ストラップやケースなど、ご自身で見た特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Are there any features you saw yourself, such as a strap or case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 灰色のストラップが付いていました。ケースは家に置いたので、公園でなくしたのは本体だけだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 灰色のストラップが付いており、ケースは家にあるので、公園でなくしたのは本体だけだと思うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: They had a gray strap. I left the case at home, so I think only the binoculars themselves were lost in the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say they have a gray strap and, since the case is at home, you think only the binoculars themselves were lost in the park. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本体とケースを分けて照会します。持ち主に確認できた情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will inquire about the binoculars separately from the case. Have you confirmed any information with the owner?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 知人から返事が来ました。ストラップに小さな補修跡があるそうです。私はその跡を見ていないので、知人から聞いた情報として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ストラップの補修跡は自分で見たものではなく、知人から返事で聞いた情報として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My acquaintance has replied. They say there is a small repair mark on the strap. I have not seen it myself, so I will identify it as information I heard from the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you did not see the repair mark on the strap yourself and that this information came from your acquaintance’s reply. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見た特徴と持ち主から聞いた特徴を分けて記録します。似た物があっても、すぐ同じ物とは決めないで確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record the features you saw separately from those you heard about from the owner. Even if something similar is found, let us check rather than immediately assume it is the same item.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 黒い本体と灰色のストラップは自分で見ました。補修跡は知人の説明です。候補があれば持ち主と特徴を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 黒い本体と灰色のストラップは自分の観察、補修跡は知人の説明として区別し、候補があれば持ち主と確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I saw the black binoculars and gray strap myself. The repair mark comes from the owner’s description. If there is a possible match, I would like to check its features with the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the black binoculars and gray strap you observed yourself from the repair mark described by the owner, and say you want to check any possible match with the owner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。届出先を確認してご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01223-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check where to make the report and advise you. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動のことで何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your journey?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 千歳から空港へ行きます。航空会社から変更の連絡が来たので、列車に乗る前に行き先を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 航空会社から変更連絡が来たため、空港行きの列車に乗る前に行き先を整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am going from Chitose to the airport. The airline has notified me of a change, so I want to clarify where I am going before boarding the train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to clarify your destination before boarding the airport train because the airline sent you a change notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 連絡では、出発空港が変わったのですか。それとも空港内の受付場所ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the notice change the departure airport, or the check-in location within the airport?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空港名は同じです。国内線の受付場所の変更で、別の空港へ行くという意味ではありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空港名は変わらず、変更されたのは国内線の受付場所だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The airport name is the same. The change concerns the domestic-flight check-in location; it did not mean I should go to another airport.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the airport name is unchanged and only the domestic-flight check-in location has changed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、列車で向かう空港と、到着後に探す受付を分けましょう。便名は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us distinguish the airport you are taking the train to from the check-in desk you will find after arrival. Can you check the flight number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 予約メールの便名を見ます。旅行サイトの広告に出た別の便ではなく、自分の予約を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広告に出た別の便ではなく、自分の予約メールで便名を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look at the flight number in my booking email. I will use my own reservation rather than a different flight advertised on a travel website.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will check the flight number in your own booking email rather than a different flight shown in an advertisement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の予約が基準ですね。空港に着いてからは、航空会社の最新案内で受付を探してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your own reservation is the reference, then. After reaching the airport, use the airline’s latest guidance to find the check-in location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物を預けるので、ホームから受付までの移動もあります。列車の到着時刻を、そのまま受付に着く時刻とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 荷物を預けるので、列車到着から受付までの移動時間も必要だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check in baggage, so I also need to get from the platform to check-in. I will not treat the train’s arrival time as the time I reach the check-in desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check in baggage and therefore also need time to travel from the train’s arrival point to check-in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。移動や手続きに必要な時間も考えて、利用する列車を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us check which train to take while allowing time for getting around and completing the procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約の空港と便名を確かめ、列車到着後の移動時間も見ます。変更した受付は航空会社の案内で探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約の空港と便名、到着後の移動時間を確認し、受付場所は航空会社の最新案内で探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the airport and flight number in my reservation and allow for travel time after the train arrives. I will find the changed check-in location using the airline’s guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check your booked airport and flight number and travel time after arrival, and find check-in using the airline’s latest guidance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お時間に余裕を持ってお出かけください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please leave plenty of time for your journey. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。生活の案内で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with local living information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ごみを出す日を調べています。保存したカレンダーが自分の地区か、住所と照らしてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保存したごみ収集日程が自分の住所の地区に合っているか確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking up garbage collection days. Could you compare the calendar I saved with my address to check whether it covers my district?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask someone to check whether the garbage collection schedule you saved matches the district for your address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カレンダーの地区名と発行年を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the district name and publication year on the calendar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地区名が隣の町でした。千歳という検索だけで、最初に出た画面を保存していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 検索時に隣の町の地区を選び、その画像を保存してしまったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The district name was in the neighboring town. I searched only for Chitose and saved the first screen that appeared.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you selected a district in the neighboring town when searching and saved that image. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の住所は北地区です。保存画像の南地区とは違います。こちらが2026年北地区の案内です。何を出す予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your current address is in the North District. It differs from the South District in the saved image. Here is the 2026 North District guide. What do you plan to put out?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 段ボールです。日付だけでなく、その地区の分け方と出す場所も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 段ボールの分別方法、収集日、出す場所を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Cardboard. Besides the date, I would like to ask how it is sorted in this district and where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check how to sort cardboard, its collection day, and where to put it out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この北地区カレンダーでは、段ボールの欄は木曜日です。まとめ方と共同の置き場は、このカレンダーだけでは決まらないので、住居の管理者にも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this North District calendar, the cardboard column says Thursday. This calendar alone does not determine how to bundle it or which communal collection point to use, so please also ask your building manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 共同の置き場があるので管理者へ聞きます。地図に近い場所があっても、自分の住居の場所と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共同のごみ置き場は建物の管理者に確認し、地図の近い場所へ勝手に出さないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a communal collection point, so I will ask the manager. Even if a place is nearby on the map, I will not assume it serves my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will confirm the communal garbage collection point with your building manager and will not put garbage at a nearby place on the map without checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 2026年北地区の段ボール欄が木曜日であることは確認できました。置き場は管理者の回答待ち、と分けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have confirmed that the cardboard column on the 2026 North District calendar says Thursday. Let us record the collection point separately as awaiting the manager’s answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 北地区2026年の段ボール欄は木曜日ですね。隣町南地区の画像は使いません。出す方法と共同置場を管理者に確認してから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 2026年北地区では段ボール欄が木曜日と確認し、隣町南地区の画像は使わず出し方と共同置場を管理者に確認してから出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: So the cardboard column for the North District in 2026 says Thursday. I will not use the image for the neighboring town’s South District. I will ask the manager how to put it out and which communal point to use before doing so.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the 2026 North District cardboard column says Thursday, and say you will not use the neighboring town’s South District image and will ask the manager about preparation and the communal point before putting it out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当の案内を確認します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the guidance from the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分と同じ名字が呼ばれましたが、私の順番か自信がありません。番号で確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ名字が呼ばれたが自分の順番か不明なので、受付番号で確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone with my surname was called, but I am not sure it is my turn. Could you check by my reception number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for your turn to be checked using your reception number because the same surname was called but you are unsure whether it was you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受付票を見せてください。呼ばれた番号は聞き取れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your reception slip. Did you catch the number that was called?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名字だけ聞こえ、呼ばれた番号はわかりません。私の票は014です。この番号で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 呼ばれた番号は聞いていないが自分の票は014なので、この番号で確認してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only heard the surname and do not know the number called. My slip says 014. Please check using this number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you did not hear the number called, but your slip says 014, and ask them to check using that number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付票で確認します。そのとき、何か書類を受け取りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check your reception slip. Did you receive any documents at that time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 机の封筒を取るように言われた気がしましたが、まだ触っていません。他の人の物かもしれないので待ちました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 机の封筒を取るよう言われた気がしたが、他の人の物かもしれないため触らず待ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought I was told to take the envelope on the desk, but I have not touched it. I waited because it might belong to someone else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you thought you were told to take the envelope on the desk but waited without touching it because it might be someone else’s. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今呼ばれた番号を確認しました。041で、あなたの014とは別です。机の封筒は受け取らずに、そのままにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I checked the number just called. It was 041, which is different from your 014. Please leave the envelope on the desk without taking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数字が同じでも順番が違いますね。私の014ではなかったとわかりました。自分の票は持ったままにして、次の案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 呼出し041は自分の014と数字の順が違うと確認し、票を持って次の案内を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The digits are the same, but their order differs. Now I understand it was not my 014. I will keep my own slip and wait for the next instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the called number 041 has a different digit order from your 014, and say you will hold on to your slip and wait for the next instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、014の現在の案内は待合でお待ちいただくことです。同じ名字の041の方とは、受付記録も分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the current instruction for 014 is to wait in the waiting area. Your reception record is separate from that of 041, who has the same surname.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の014は待合で待つ案内ですね。041の封筒は取らず、次に呼ばれた時も自分の票と番号を照合します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 014は待合で待つ案内と復唱し、041の封筒は取らず次回も自分の受付票と呼出し番号を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: So 014 should wait in the waiting area. I will not take 041’s envelope, and next time I am called I will compare the number with my own slip again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that 014 is to wait in the waiting area, and say you will not take 041’s envelope and will compare future called numbers with your own reception slip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 番号とご本人への案内を確認できました。014の受付票をお持ちください。お待ちいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed your number and the instructions meant for you. Please keep your 014 reception slip. Thank you for waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 知人に一時的に貸した家の鍵が戻りません。連絡もつかないので、どう相談すればよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 知人に貸した家の鍵が返らず連絡もつかないため、相談方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The house key I lent an acquaintance temporarily has not been returned. I cannot contact them either, so I would like to ask how to seek advice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to seek advice because the house key you lent an acquaintance has not been returned and you cannot contact them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、何のために貸しましたか。返す約束はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When did you lend it, and for what purpose? Was there an agreement to return it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日、忘れた荷物を届けてもらうために貸しました。その日の夜に返す約束でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 昨日、忘れた荷物を届けてもらうために鍵を貸し、その夜に返す約束だったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I lent it yesterday so they could deliver some belongings I had forgotten. They promised to return it that evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you lent the key yesterday so the acquaintance could deliver belongings you forgot, and they promised to return it that night. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 鍵が返っていないことは確認できていますね。その後、家の中に入られた様子はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You have confirmed that the key has not been returned. Has there been any sign that someone entered your home since then?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 鍵がないことは確かですが、入られたかはわかりません。連絡がないだけで侵入したとは言いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵が返っていないことは確かだが入られたかは不明で、連絡がないだけで侵入を断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am certain the key is missing, but I do not know whether anyone entered. I will not say they entered just because they have not contacted me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the key definitely has not been returned, but entry is unknown, and you will not conclude there was an intrusion merely because there has been no contact. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる事実を記録しましょう。鍵を貸した時のやり取りは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us record the facts that can be confirmed. Do you still have the messages exchanged when you lent the key?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: メッセージに返す時刻があります。鍵の写真もありますが、写真があるから今の所在がわかるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返却時刻のメッセージと鍵の写真はあるが、写真から現在の所在は分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The message includes the return time. I have a photo of the key too, but having a photo does not mean I know where it is now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have a message showing the return time and a photo of the key, but the photo does not tell you its current location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その記録を見せてください。住居の安全に関する相談は、管理者への連絡も含め担当と確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show us those records. Let us discuss home safety with the person in charge, including contacting the property manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 貸した目的、返す約束、返っていないことを説明します。管理者にも連絡し、鍵の扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 貸した目的、返却の約束、未返却の事実を示し、管理者にも連絡して鍵の扱いを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain why I lent it, the promise to return it, and the fact that it has not been returned. I would also like to contact the manager and discuss what to do about the key.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State why you lent the key, the return agreement, and the fact it remains unreturned, and say you want to contact the manager and discuss how to handle the key. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へおつなぎします。現在危険を感じる場合はすぐお知らせください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the person in charge. Please tell us immediately if you currently feel in danger. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。荷物について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 相手に発送したと言ったのですが、荷物が家に残っていました。送り状を作っただけだったか、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相手に発送済みと伝えた荷物が家に残っており、送り状を作っただけか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I told the recipient I had sent it, but the parcel was still at home. I want to check whether I only created the shipping label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say a parcel you told the recipient had been shipped was still at home, and you want to check whether you only created its shipping label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引受けの控えはありますか。それとも送り状を作った画面ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a receipt showing it was accepted for shipping, or just the label creation screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っているのは送り状の作成画面です。窓口へ持ってきた記憶はなく、箱も玄関にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: あるのは送り状の作成画面で、窓口に持参した記憶はなく箱も玄関にあったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: What I have is the shipping label creation screen. I do not remember bringing it to the counter, and the box was by the front entrance too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the label creation screen, do not remember taking the parcel to the counter, and found the box by your front entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作成とお預かりは別ですね。今ある箱を発送する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Creating the label and handing over the parcel are separate steps. Do you plan to send the box you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。でも昨日発送済みと伝えたのは訂正します。今日送れるか確認してから、新しい予定を相手に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送済みという連絡を訂正し、今日発送できるか確認してから新しい予定を相手に知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. But I will correct what I said yesterday about having shipped it. I will check whether I can send it today before telling the recipient the new plan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will correct your message that it had shipped and tell the recipient the new plan after checking whether it can be sent today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 箱の準備と宛先を確認してから、受付方法をご案内できます。古い送り状はその箱用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking the box’s preparation and recipient, we can explain how to hand it over. Is the old label for that box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前に送った別の箱の控えも混ざっています。今回の宛先と照合して、違う番号を相手へ知らせないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 以前送った別の箱の控えも混ざっているので、今回の宛先を照合して誤った番号を知らせないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: A receipt for a different box I sent before is mixed in too. I will compare it with this parcel’s recipient so I do not give the recipient the wrong number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say a receipt for another box sent earlier is mixed in, so you will check this parcel’s recipient and avoid giving the wrong number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回の箱に対応する情報で確認しましょう。お預かり後の控えは別に保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check using the information corresponding to this box. Please keep the receipt issued after we accept it separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回の箱と宛先を確認して持ってきます。相手にはまだ預けていなかったと訂正し、引受け後に番号を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回の箱と宛先を確認して持参し、未引受けだったと相手に訂正して、引受け後に番号を伝えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check this box and its recipient and bring it in. I will correct my message to the recipient, saying I had not handed it over yet, and provide the number after it is accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will check this box and its recipient before bringing it in, correct your message to say it had not been accepted yet, and provide the number after acceptance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたら受付へお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it to the counter when it is ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お支払いの記録で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your payment records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同居人と買い物代を分けます。カードの利用速報と明細の両方に同じ金額があるので、二回払ったのか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同居人と買い物代を分担するが、利用速報と請求明細に同じ金額があり二重払いなのか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am splitting shopping costs with my housemate. The same amount appears in both a card usage alert and the statement, so I would like to ask whether I paid twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you paid twice because the same amount appears in a usage alert and billing statement for shopping costs you will share with your housemate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 店名と利用日は同じですか。表示されている記録の種類も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are the store name and transaction date the same? Let us also check what kind of records are displayed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 店名と日付は同じです。片方は速報で、もう片方は請求の明細です。合計して同居人へ請求しかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店名と日付が同じ速報と明細を足して、同居人に請求しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The store name and date are the same. One is an alert, and the other is the billing statement. I nearly added them together and charged my housemate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you nearly added together the alert and statement with the same store name and date and charged your housemate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この二つは同じ店名、利用日、金額ですが、速報は未確定、明細は請求の記録です。同じ取引を示す可能性があるため、二回分と足す根拠にはできません。別々の取引かはカード担当の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: These show the same store name, transaction date, and amount, but the alert is provisional while the statement is a billing record. They may refer to the same transaction, so they are not grounds for adding two payments together. The card representative needs to check whether they are separate transactions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同居人への請求はいったん待ちます。確認した一回分を基に分けたいので、記録の意味を問い合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同居人への請求はいったん待ち、確認できた一回分を基に分担するため記録の意味を問い合わせたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait before charging my housemate. I want to split the cost based on one confirmed payment, so I will ask what these records mean.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait before charging your housemate and want to ask what the records mean so you can split the cost based on one confirmed payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お問い合わせでは、どの金額を足したのか伝えてください。購入した品の内訳はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When inquiring, please explain which amounts you added. Do you know the breakdown of the items purchased?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートには共用の食品と私だけの物があります。カードの確認が済んでも、全額を半分にするとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートには共用品と自分だけの物があるので、確認後も全額を半分にするとは限らないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: The receipt includes shared food and items only for me. Even after the card issue is checked, we will not necessarily split the full amount in half.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the receipt includes shared items and things only for you, so even after checking you will not necessarily halve the entire amount. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照会メモには速報と請求明細を別々に示しました。レシートの共用食品とご本人だけの品も分けてあります。支払い回数の確認と、同居人との分担の相談は別に進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The inquiry note lists the alert and billing statement separately. The shared food and your personal items on the receipt are also separated. Please handle checking the number of payments separately from discussing the split with your housemate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当へ速報と明細の関係を聞き、共用品の分だけ同居人と相談します。同じ取引を二度足して請求しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当者に速報と明細の関係を確認し、共用品の分を同居人と相談して、同じ取引を二度請求しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask the representative how the alert relates to the statement and discuss only the shared items with my housemate. I will not add the same transaction twice and charge them for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the representative how the alert and statement relate, discuss the shared items with your housemate, and not charge for the same transaction twice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。取引確認の窓口をご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the transaction inquiry desk. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。売場で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you in the sales area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会計したあと袋を置き忘れたかもしれません。ここで買った物と、ほかの店の物が一緒なので、特徴を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会計後に他の店の商品も入れた買い物袋を忘れ、特徴を伝えて探してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I may have left my bag after paying. It contains items bought here and at another store, so I would like to describe it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you left a shopping bag after checkout that also contains another store’s products, and ask for help finding it by describing its features. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 最後に袋を持っていた場所は覚えていますか。購入の控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the last place you had the bag? Do you have a purchase receipt?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会計のレシートがあります。その後に袋詰めの台を使い、そこからは持ったか覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートはあるが、袋詰め台を離れた後に袋を持っていたか思い出せないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the checkout receipt. I used the bagging counter afterward, and I do not remember whether I took the bag from there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the receipt but cannot remember whether you had the bag after leaving the bagging counter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の色や中身を教えてください。別の方の荷物を勝手に持たず、担当に照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us the bag’s color and contents. Do not take someone else’s belongings yourself; let us ask the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い持参袋です。ここで買ったパンと、別の店で買ったノートがあります。パンだけでは区別できないと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 青い持参の袋に、この店のパンと別の店で買ったノートが入っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is my own blue shopping bag. It has bread bought here and a notebook bought at another store. I do not think the bread alone would distinguish it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your own blue bag contains bread from this store and a notebook bought at another store. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 両方の特徴を記録します。ノートは何か印がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will record both features. Does the notebook have any identifying mark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表紙の角に名前のシールがあります。公開するのではなく、担当に見せるメモへ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ノートの隅に名前のシールがあるので、人前では読み上げず担当者にメモで示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a name sticker on the corner of its cover. Rather than disclose it publicly, I will write it in a note to show the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the notebook has a name sticker in a corner and that you want to show it to the person in charge in a note rather than read it aloud in front of others. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が届いた物と確認します。袋を見かけても、ご自身の物か確認してから受け取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will compare it with items handed in. Even if you see a bag, please confirm it is yours before accepting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 袋詰め台と青い袋、パンと名前シールのノートを伝えます。レシートも示して担当の照合を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 袋詰め台、袋の特徴、中身、名前の印をレシートとともに示し、照合を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will describe the bagging counter, the blue bag, the bread, and the notebook with a name sticker. I will show my receipt too and wait for the person in charge to compare the details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will provide the bagging counter location, bag features, contents, and name marking along with the receipt, and wait for them to be matched. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ確認します。お知らせいただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the person in charge. Thank you for letting us know.
